svg.title: Mockup 12: the incident lifecycle and who hears what
svg.text: 12 · The incident lifecycle, the alert kinds and who hears what (everyone, implicitly)
canccumanager's incident rules kept (its alert tests are the spec), with the legacy's known problems fixed. Times are the defaults (D2, O7).
Use case: the reviewer, the builder and the session read one picture of when an alert speaks, who hears it, and what it emits
back to ok first: nothing is said
A reminder every 30 min, as a reply under the post, with the
incident's start and the state now (legacy F9).
Slow → down inside an incident: the same post is edited.
No post, no reminder, no auto-fix until the mute ends; Health
still shows it. A mute that ends while not ok reminds at once
4 changes in 10 min: one "keeps changing" edit, then quiet
until it holds 5 min (E4). A new version answering: its part's
incidents wait 3 min (deploy grace, E5). One cause, many parts:
P4: "gave up" and "blocked" are timeline entries, not states.
P7: an undelivered recovery is retried every 5 min (E2).
P6: every actor is a signed-in user, never a header.
The alert kinds (D1) and who hears them
id, kind, subject, state, since, audience
Event alerts on t:<event>:events:admin; platform ones on events:admin. Words and ids only: never secrets or log lines.
